newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end lower on yen"s rise.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end lower on yen"s rise.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended lower across the board on Wednesday, depressed by the yen"s rise against the dollar, traders said.
Prices ranged from 2.2 yen to 4.0 yen per kg lower. Most-active benchmark July was off 3.9 yen at 157.8 yen.
The market started the day in negative territory as profit-taking emerged after price rises on Wednesday.

"The market continued to suffer from a lack of fresh factors to push up prices," an analyst at a commodity broker said. "A moderate technical correction is likely to continue for the near-term," he said. --Tokyo Commodity Desk
